data.name: Tru Blu Renovations of Pools, Inc.

reviews.text:
Tru Blu Pool Renovations is without a doubt the best company to do a complete pool remodel.  Our pool was about 40 years old and in need of repairs.  I did my research and fortunately found Tru Blue Renovations.  We had our pool completely redone from decking, plumbing, skimmers, tanning deck built into the pool, waterfall, lighting and the new pebble plaster.  Everything that they did was 100% perfection.  The crew was professional and knowledgeable and aimed to please.
We had never had a Polaris cleaner before, but Mark made sure that we included that.  The best thing that we ever had.  It cuts down on cleaning to zero effort.

It has been about three years since we had the makeover, and we are so pleased with Mark and his company.   I would highly recommend Tru Blu Pool Renovations because renovations is what they do.  They only remodel pools.

If you ever meet Mark, you will see how he loves what he does.  He has been doing this type of work for many, many years.

James and Carla Sams
Fort Worth
reviews.author: James Sams

reviews.text: We moved into the area this past summer and discovered that our pool had been "patched up"  for cosmetics but had not been properly repaired and there were several leaks. We decided to completely renovate and called around to several companies. Only 2 responded to our calls. Mark came out the same day we called. He was very personable and patient with our many questions and concerns. Once we decided to go with them, they started work immediately, the week of Christmas! All the crews have been very nice and efficient. Each day they cleaned up before they left and progress was easily seen. Today is January 2 and we are a few hours away from refilling the pool. Key reasons we picked them: the owner is very involved in the business, he focuses only on renovations and has done so for 20+ years.  He runs his own crews and does not subcontract.  I highly recommend Tru Blu for pool renovations!
reviews.author: Robbin Hallford

reviews.text:
Our pool was completed almost 20 years ago and was in dire need of repair. Mark helped us pick out the tile, pebble color and the flagstone for the edging around the pool and spa.
His recommendation for the spa stonework vastly improved its appearance. The flagstone edging has a lot of S curves in it - Mark's talented stone masons did a wonderful job.
They also repainted and sealed the pool deck and it looks great as well.
Mark, the owner, came by every day to make sure everything was going well. We highly recommend TruBlu
reviews.author: Keith Kiser

reviews.text: Great customer service on a timely manner. Mark Paulson has been doing  my pool renovation service for last 3 years. He has been very honest and has repaired multiple minor problems without charge in good faith in last 3 years..
reviews.author: Sankar Saha

reviews.text:
We had our pool renovated several years ago and when it was done it LOOKED fantastic. However, the follow up, service and quality of materials have proven to be disappointing. The edge coping they put in is a type of sandstone which degrades so that lots of sand gets in the pool and it is difficult for the Polaris sweeper to pick up.

The Breeze Salt cell chlorinator Tru Blue installed worked great, but it fell off the wall when the screws didn’t hold, but the unit did not break. Tru Blue came out to screw it back up and it fell a second time and broke when it fell. I spent $1500 dollars getting a new salt cell installed. If they had just done it right the first I would still be using the original salt cell. Not recommended.
reviews.author: Mike Milliken

reviews.text: Tru Blu has refurbished my pool twice.  I appreciated the input from Mark about tile and plaster choices.  I have called him recently to add a handrail and his guys were superb. Also, he sent his guy to clean the calcium from the tile.  Tru Blu always does above board work and very easy to work with them. I have also recommended them to three of my neighbors. Great company - call them.
reviews.author: Carol DeVinny

reviews.text: I would NOT recommend this company to anyone! I paid 12K to repair crack and re-plaster my pool. Six months after the crack came back due to them NOT doing the repair correctly. They also did not fully remove (sandblast) paint off and now the plaster has to be removed, sandblasted again and repair the crack correctly. I am facing another 30K in cost to fix what Mark did not do correctly!
reviews.author: Rusty Hassell

reviews.text: Mark and his crew did a great job replastering our pool, fixing deck cracks, new mastic and superb clean up. Cost for the materials and workmanship are competitive.  Great customer service throughout and after the process. They start early and finish late. They want the job done right. I have used their services twice in the past 15 years and am totally a sold customer.. Thanks Mark,  Caleb, Rafael and Crew.
reviews.author: William Mattingly

reviews.text: Mark came out to do an estimate on our skimmer repair project within 24 hours of calling. He even came out on a Saturday, which was impressive.  Our piping under our deck had a leak and we had to reroute a new pipeline underground from the skimmer around our property to the pool equipment. His partner, who came out to do the digging, completed the project in 3 days and our skimmer is now working great! My only complaint, and reason for a 4/5 star review, is that a mess was left in our backyard grass. None of the dug up grass was put back and flattened in place. I reached out to Mark the day the repair was completed and reported how the grass was left a mess. Unfortunately, despite a week passing by, he never came back out to our house to fix the problem. Needless to say, this morning I spent 3 hours cleaning up the mess and appropriately putting the grass back where it belonged. You can see the mess that was left with the attached picture. I would use Tru Blu Pool services again in the future, but would be weary that the cleanup job may not be as thorough as the actual job repair performed.
reviews.author: Josh Zaffos

reviews.text: Great company . Had to schedule out a month ahead. Well worth the wait Great follow up and a great team of sub contractors! Exceeded our expectation and followed up on all issues. Trust is important and they have mine. Would rehire and recommend to all.
reviews.author: Linwood Henderson

reviews.text:
Mark and his crew are the best. I've have pool completely renovated. They have built a sidewalk around one area of the pool. Found a leak in the concrete and fixed that as well. I've never had to wait to get them out to give me a quote. They
have always done the job quickly and efficiently.  I would recommend this company to any of my family and friends.
reviews.author: Martha Payne

reviews.text:
My wife and I have been proud pool owners for over 22 years and often handle our own repairs. A few years ago, we were in need of a pool renovation and after researching various companies, we came across Tru Blu Renovations. Let me tell you, it was an absolute blessing to find these guys. Mark, the owner, is a truly caring business owner, a rare gem in today's world. And their Service Manager, German, is an absolute master at his craft.
Thanks to their expertise and dedication, our pool has been transformed into a sparkling beauty. Recently, we encountered two separate repair issues that had us stumped, and we were worried about the potential cost of fixing them. Thankfully, I reached out to Mark, and both times he promptly sent German to our rescue the very next day. Not only were the issues expertly resolved, but the pricing was incredibly fair. It was a refreshing reminder that there are still good, honest people out there.
We cannot recommend Tru Blu Renovations enough. Their professionalism, skill, and integrity are unmatched. If you're in need of pool services, look no further. Trust me, you won't be disappointed!
reviews.author: Mark & Barbara Pico

reviews.text:
I have used True Blu on two pool complete renovations once in 2016 and the second one 2023. The results were outstanding.  Mark always answers the phone personally and stands behind his work.  Last week, while on an overseas trip, the pool pump malfunctioned and needed a new impeller.  I called him from Thailand and he ,promptly sent a crew the fix it.  I highly recommend Tru Blu and Mark Paulson
Dennis O
reviews.author: Big D

reviews.text: Tru Blue was fantastic to work with throughout the entire process. Mark is very knowledgeable and brought a lot of great ideas through the design process. The crew was always timely and hard working and left the work site clean and beautiful. Caleb was great to work with as the project manager, great communication and made the process a breeze. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Corey Anderson

reviews.text: The crew at Tru Blu Pool Renovations are truly amazing, great to work with, very responsive, & reasonably priced. Have used them for years for all sorts of repairs & even a complete pool make over including plaster, tile, coping, & decking. Thank you Tru Blu!
reviews.author: Keith Rowe

reviews.text: Awesome job!!  Very happy with everything!
reviews.author: Eric Sturm

reviews.text:
We have contracted with Mark and Tru Blu over the past years for several pool repairs, some major as well as a complete pool re-plaster job last year and have nothing other to say except we made the right choice going with Mark and Tru Blu.

During the recent freeze our pool/spa heater failed and could not run pump.

I contacted Mark on a Friday concerning this and Mark met with me the next day.

Bottom line, Mark and Tru Blu are very competitive, reasonably priced,  possesses professional knowledge  in the field and are very responsive.

New heater was  delivered, installed and pool was up and running on Tuesday.

Will contract with any future repairs with Tru Blu and strongly recommend Mark and Tru Blu for your pool repair needs.

Shawn Keefe
reviews.author: Shawn Keefe

reviews.text: We hired Tru Blu to replace tile and coping around our pool. The job eventually got done.. but the workmanship from the contractors were sub par. The grout is messy and the inside of the stones look bad. I gave up on asking for things to be corrected. When you pay this much for something you would hope the Manager of the company would look at it and say this needs to be fixed... not wait for the customer to do it. My coping was not sealed so after one year it is discoloring and chipping. The grout is already cracking. Just disappointing.
reviews.author: Felicia Berry

reviews.text: Tru Blu has remodeled / renovated our pool twice, first in 2004 and again in 2015. Mark and his crews are easy to work with and do great work. The pricing is very fair and most importantly Tru Blu hits their dates. i.e. Start date for demo, tile and coping, plaster install, etc. Hitting dates may not sound like a big deal but anyone who's had work done at their home can attest that it is a huge deal and it's comforting to know the Tru Blu Crew will be there on the day that is scheduled. Weather permitting, can't stop the weather!
reviews.author: Keith Murphy

reviews.text:
We used Tru Blue in 2010 to resurface our pool and our decking.  I know what you're thinking, "why wait until now to write a review?"  Immediately after TB resurfaced our pool, the main light and spa light were not working.  We asked them to fix them and the owner told us it was impossible and that they tried.  A few weeks later we got a guy to fix them no problem.
Within the first year or so we noticed discoloration of the plaster all over the shallow end.  The plaster looked stained and worse than what we had prior to.  Also within the first year we saw that the cool deck began cracking in places or just random chunks were popping out.  Again, this looked worse than what we we had in the first place.
We recently had a couple companies come out to give us a quote on resurfacing.  The one we chose to go with is also our pool maintenance company.  He gave us a quote that was higher than Tru Blu (back in 2010), but we also went with an upgraded pebble surface over the traditional plaster.  Once the water was drained and the guys began prepping the surface they could tell that they needed to remove all of the prior plaster mainly because the last resurfacing job (done by Tru Blu) was, as the owner of the company doing the work "one of the "worst plaster jobs I've ever seen in my career, everything about it was done incorrectly."  So, we had to pay an additional $1,600 to have the mistakes of Tru Blu undone.
My advice, shop around for quotes.  We were young and were probably looking for the best price back then.  But you do get what you pay for.  True Blu sticks out because of this issue and as one of the worst home projects we have done due to the attitude of the owner and the level of work.  Look elsewhere.
reviews.author: Patrick Reilly

reviews.text: I just had Mark's company resurface my pool, installed handrails to get in and out of the pool, repair some cracked up coping and replace the mastic seal around the perimeter of the pool. The did a fabulous job. In out in a few days and each crew was professional and polite. Very happy I chose them!
reviews.author: Gary Capik

reviews.text: Tru Blu examined our existing spa - listened to our “wish list” and provided numerous concept depictions. Mark reacted professionally / patiently and produced a final version that we liked & approved. The construction crew was clean, prompt and hard working; the tear down / reconstruction was accomplished on time and the clean up operation was effective and thorough. Mark exceeded our expectations - provided a new spa that we are already using / enjoying - at a package price that was more than fair! If there was a rating above 5 stars, Tru Blu earned & would most certainly receive it. HIGHLY recommend this company.
reviews.author: archiecr2160

reviews.text:
I needed a replaster job.  After a few quotes, Mark was the only one that identified the crack behind my tile as a coping problem.  The others all just said that they could patch it.  It required removing a lot of coping to redo the mortar.
They found a few tiles that matched my very old tile and it was just enough  (honestly, we had to use a few chipped tiles, but I really don't mind and it's way better than retiling the whole pool.  Plus I like the vintage tile).
It looks fantastic with the new Stonescapes finish and fixed tile.
I did have a small issue after we initially filled the pool but Mark sent some guys out to fix it up.  I'm letting you know because it's good to hear what happens when an issue comes up, rather than just having the flawless experience.
reviews.author: Joe A

reviews.text: Mark and his team of professionals delivered everything we expected and more. We love our “new” pool. On time On budget and On target with the end results. Thank you True Blue!!
reviews.author: Joseph DeAntona

reviews.text:
Mark of Tru Blue Pools did a wonderful job on my pool, replaced all the sidewalk decking, fixed cracks in the pool, new diving board... Very fast and
reliable. Always answers any messages quick.. I would highly reccomend them. Great work.
reviews.author: Julie Bonk

reviews.text: Mark at TruBlue has been patient and understanding through the months it took me to finally get my heater installed. Thank you for your professionalism and the quality service.
reviews.author: Lachelle Shelton

reviews.text: Tru Blue did a complete renovation on our gunite pool about ten years ago. It still  looks great and the price was reasonable. Recently they did a minor repair and did an excellent job. We will always use them again as they do what they say they will do at a decent price. What more can you ask .
reviews.author: Chuck Rearick

reviews.text: I paid $4,200.00 to have the pool replastered, inlets replaced and the existing tile regrouted.  The job is a total disaster as the pool sides and bottom are stained and discolored, the tile was left with an incredible amount of splatter and haze from the plaster/mortar that was used and left uncleaned and the inlets that were installed are undersized, very cheap looking and improperly attached.  This company uses sub contractors for all of the labor and they have no control over the quality of the work.  The warranty is worthless because the sub contractors have been  paid and have no incentive to return.  After six months of promises, excuses and delays I told Mark Paulson (owner/salesman) that I wanted a refund since it was obvious that his people were not interested or capable of repairing the mess that he had left me with.  He offered a very small refund to not hold him liable for the problems with the pool.  The check and offer are currently being reviewed by my lawyer to determine our next step.  Please do not make the same mistake that I did and hire this guy.
reviews.author: Franklin Weeks

reviews.text: Be very careful dealing with this company long story short lack of communication, owner only shows when he wants payment. He will ask for final payment before job is 100% complete. We have had problems since before they finished and when we addressed it with him he says oh we can fix that later. A couple emails sent out about the issues only response was “Ok” sent his guy out and part of the deck they poured  is uneven and it sticks out, part of the pool finish the pebble finish is bubbling up where the pool wasn’t prepped correctly for the stone finish, safety fence holes that he said he would re drill for our fence still haven’t been drilled. The Pool light that his guys uninstalled and reinstalled doesn’t work correctly and has water sitting in it. Has no sense of urgency to the customer concerns or needs, doesn’t schedule with the customer his workers just show up unannounced and go straight to the work with home owner having no knowledge of them being here. Pay attention to the details because Mark and his team don’t.
reviews.author: JT Jones III

reviews.text: Tru Blu Pools has been servicing my pool and equipment for the last five years. They have always been quick to respond and have always done an excellent job. They have done major and minor repairs for me and  I would highly recommend them for your pool needs.
reviews.author: David Neill

reviews.text: As a Realtor, I am asked for recommendations about pool work often, and I always send them to Tru Blu. Not only are they genuine and professional, I know and trust that they service clients with the same respect, courtesy and professionalism that I strive to give my own clients.
reviews.author: Logan Nichols

reviews.text: We are extremely pleased with Tru Blu's professional work. We're so happy with the finished results and the continued multiple follow ups. Would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Justin Gaul

reviews.text: Mark was the only company who found me a near-exact match to replace my 20-yr old pool tile. And Noe & Rosie were a very sweet couple who did an extraordinary job with the repair! Thank You !!
reviews.author: Chris Young

reviews.text: We love our new pebble tech pool! Mark and his crew did a great job for us! This is our second pool reno with Mark. Highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Tracey Schultz

reviews.text: The owner truly values quality and it shows in his work. Their crew is reliable and does an amazing job. Genuine people produces genuine work. I would highly recommend them to anyone. Great customer service! Thank you!
reviews.author: Miki Rezentes

reviews.text: We are extremely pleased with TruBlu’s professional work. We are so happy with the finished results and the continued multiple follow ups. Would highly recommend!
reviews.author: Taylor Chaffey

reviews.text: Tru Blu did a fantastic job updating and resurfacing our existing pool and deck.
reviews.author: Joe Garza

reviews.text: They renovated our pool and did a great job!  Maintained communication throughout.  Looks like a new pool.  Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Glen Cline
